title: Obsidian Wiki Multi-Vault Registry
description: Registry of Obsidian vaults managed by this repository. Consumed by lib/resolve-wiki.sh and .skills/autoresearch/.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor validation.

version.description: Semantic version of this registry file format.

default.description: Name of the default wiki (must match a key in `wikis`).

vault.description: Relative path from repo root to the Obsidian vault directory. REQUIRED and must exist on disk.

sources.description: Path to raw source documents (PDFs, markdown corpus). Can be absolute (outside repo) or relative. May be null if the wiki has no external source corpus.

raw_source.description: Optional absolute path to the raw source artifact (e.g., a single PDF) that lives outside the repository. Used only by extraction workflows, not by the autoresearch loop.

extractions.description: Relative path to the processed intermediate output directory (e.g., Datalab chapter extractions). May be null if the wiki does not use an extraction pipeline.

tools.description: Relative path to wiki-specific tooling (extraction scripts, augmenters). May be null.

domain.description: Short descriptor of the wiki's subject domain (e.g., 'anatomy', 'clinical', 'surgical').
